# thoth_endpoint_api_key (Resource)

Creates and manages scoped JIT Thoth API keys.

This resource creates keys fixed to `endpoint` scope.

## Gateway key

A key of `kind = "mcp_gateway"` is the runtime key of the customer-hosted MCP gateway. It is endpoint-scoped and
execute-only, and it names the agents and tools it may act for, so a stolen key cannot name any other agent under the
endpoint or any other tool. The rules are checked at plan time with the same rules the server applies:

- `permissions` must be exactly `["execute"]`.
- `allowed_agents` and `allowed_tools` are both required, and are rejected without `kind = "mcp_gateway"`.
- An agent is an exact id (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no space, `*`, `/` or `\`) that is already on the
  endpoint (the server checks that).
- A tool is `<upstream>__<tool>` exactly, or `<upstream>__<tool prefix>*` with one trailing `*` after at least 3
  characters. The upstream is letters, digits, `-` and `_` (no `__`, not ending in `_`); the tool is letters, digits
  and `_ - . :` and does not start with `_`.
- At most 64 entries each. The server lower-cases, de-duplicates and sorts them; the configured spelling is kept in
  state when it only differs in case or repeats.

Changing `kind`, `allowed_agents` or `allowed_tools` replaces the key (a new secret). The key is returned once, in
`api_key`, which stays sensitive. A gateway key issued before the lists existed shows `needs_reissue = true` in the
rows of the `thoth_api_keys` data source (`data_json`) and must be replaced.

```terraform
resource "thoth_endpoint_api_key" "gateway" {
  name            = "mcp-gateway"
  scope_target_id = "endpoint-123"
  permissions     = ["execute"]
  kind            = "mcp_gateway"
  allowed_agents  = ["invoice-processor-prod"]
  allowed_tools   = ["metabase__run_query", "github__search_*"]
  ttl_seconds     = 7776000
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (List of String) Allowed permissions: read, write, execute.
- `scope_target_id` (String) Endpoint ID targeted by this API key scope.

### Optional

- `allowed_agents` (Set of String) Required when `kind = "mcp_gateway"`, rejected otherwise. Exact ids of agents under this endpoint (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no space, `*`, `/` or `\`) that the key may act for. At most 64. The server lower-cases the ids; every id must already be on the endpoint. Changing it replaces the key.
- `allowed_tools` (Set of String) Required when `kind = "mcp_gateway"`, rejected otherwise. Tools the key may ask about, each `<upstream>__<tool>` exactly, or `<upstream>__<tool prefix>*` with one trailing `*` after at least 3 characters. The upstream is letters, digits, `-` and `_` (no `__`, not ending in `_`); the tool is letters, digits and `_ - . :` and does not start with `_`; each part is at most 128 characters. At most 64. The server lower-cases the names. Changing it replaces the key.
- `jit_reason` (String) Audit reason for just-in-time issuance.
- `kind` (String) Key kind. Omit for an ordinary key. `mcp_gateway` issues the runtime key of the customer-hosted MCP gateway: it needs `permissions = ["execute"]` and both `allowed_agents` and `allowed_tools`. Changing it replaces the key.
- `name` (String) Display name for the API key.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) TTL in seconds for key expiry.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether key is currently active and not expired/revoked.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) One-time plaintext API key (returned only on create).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp.
- `id` (String) Resource ID (key ID).
- `key_id` (String) GovAPI key identifier.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last authorization timestamp.
- `prefix` (String) Key prefix for operator identification.
- `scope_level` (String) Fixed scope for this resource type.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID from provider configuration.
